page.layout: One printed page, no text blocks. The faint lines at the top, the grey image in the centre and the line with a date at the lower centre are mirrored show-through from the reverse side of the leaf.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through. The mirrored lines at the top (reading roughly "...Ioannis Vtilii ... Iohanne ... collegium") and the mirrored date at the lower centre, with a line between them, come from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. The grey rectangular image in the centre is a mirrored woodcut or device, also show-through. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on this side.
